app.title: Skills Manager
app.subtitle: Powered by the Vercel skills CLI

common.dataOutOfDate: Data may be out of date
common.multiSelectHint: Selection mode — click cards to select

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.subtitle: Your skills, as the Vercel skills CLI sees them

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: {{count}} global skill(s)
library.empty: No skills installed yet. Everything you install lands in ~/.agents/skills and stays usable by the CLI without this app.
library.lockUnavailable: The skills CLI lock file could not be read. Source metadata is unavailable; the files themselves are fine.
library.untrackedNoUpdate: Source unknown — update is unavailable for this skill
library.docTruncated: SKILL.md is large; only the beginning is shown.
library.removeMessage: Uninstall {{name}}? The skills CLI removes its files and links; anything else on disk is untouched.
library.updateMessage: Update {{name}} from its source? Local changes to the skill are overwritten.

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: {{detected}} of {{total}} known agents detected on this machine
agents.noneDetected: No agent skills directories detected yet.
agents.sharedVisibilityNote: Agents that read the shared ~/.agents/skills directory see every skill in it. Removing a per-agent link does not hide the skill from them.

project.title: Project
project.subtitle: Manage the skills of one project folder
project.pickerHint: Pick a project folder. Its skills live in .agents/skills and skills-lock.json inside that folder — this app only reads them; the CLI writes them.
project.empty: No project skills found. Install some, or run the skills CLI in this folder.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.subtitle: Search skills.sh — installation runs through the skills CLI
marketplace.sourcePlaceholder: Or enter a source: owner/repo, https://…, /local/path

installDialog.title: Install skills
installDialog.agentsHint: Choose explicitly — 'Select all' targets every known agent and is rarely what you want.
installDialog.copyModeHint: Copies files into each agent directory instead of linking the shared one
installDialog.allSkillsHint: All skills in the source will be installed; the CLI decides the exact set.
installDialog.writesBlocked: The skills CLI is missing or older than 1.7.0 — install or upgrade it to enable writes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Runtime diagnostics and preferences
settings.writesBlocked: Disabled — CLI missing or too old
settings.pickCliTitle: Choose the skills CLI (bin/cli.mjs or the skills binary)
settings.aboutBody: Skills Manager is a desktop front end for the open Vercel skills CLI. It keeps no database of its own: your skills live in ~/.agents/skills and your projects, owned by the CLI.
settings.aboutVercel: Uninstall this app at any time — installed skills keep working with the CLI and every compatible agent.

help.title: How Skills Manager works
help.description: A read-and-drive front end for the Vercel skills CLI

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: See what's installed, which agents are detected, and whether the runtime is healthy.

library.title: Library
library.description: All global skills from the shared directory and every agent directory, deduplicated. Unknown sources show a yellow badge.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Browse skills per agent. Shared-directory agents see everything in ~/.agents/skills.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Open one project folder at a time. Its .agents/skills and skills-lock.json stay inside the project.

install.title: Install & update
install.description: Every install, update and uninstall is executed by the skills CLI. This app never writes skill files or lock files itself.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Global skills live in ~/.agents/skills for every agent. Project skills live in the project and are checked into version control.

settings.title: Diagnostics
settings.description: Node and CLI locations, the lock file path, and the last CLI error live in Settings.

ownership.title: Your data stays yours
ownership.description: No database, no cloud. Remove this app and your skills keep working with the CLI unchanged.

shareDialog.title: Share skill
shareDialog.hint: Creates a symlink in each selected agent's skills dir pointing at this folder — no skills CLI involved, and the folder itself is not moved or copied.
shareDialog.conflictMessage: The agents below already hold their own copy of this skill. Sharing replaces those folders with links to this one — local edits inside them will be lost.
shareDialog.retryMessage: The agents below have something else at this skill's spot (another link, or a copy). Confirm to replace it with a link to this skill — local edits inside a real copy will be lost.
